reference: Previously inspected AI development shape audit, not independent expert validation.
primary_metrics: Per-literal-shape AP, macro AP; secondary allowed-set top-choice accuracy. All models and three-seed ensembles; no selection.
extra_stratum: External images whose genus is absent from full training, using exact genus strings.
scope: No claim of validating the entire 36-output trait vocabulary.
controls: Matched whole-image view before/after detector-box erasure. The earlier crop-versus-erased-whole-image contrast is confounded by view and is not a causal comparison.
